facts.heading: Jana divorced husband Radka
facts.content: Jana and Radka decided to divorce after 15 years of marriage.
facts.evidence: Radka and I have decided to divorce

facts.heading: Divorce announced in September
facts.content: Radka told Jana the divorce was final in September last year.
facts.evidence: in September he told me that it's not possible anymore

facts.heading: Jana has two children
facts.content: Jana has two children named Aniška (12) and Matěj (8).
facts.evidence: I have two kids. Aniška is 12 and Matěj is 8 years old.

facts.heading: Children not told of divorce yet
facts.content: Jana and Radka have postponed telling their children about the divorce.
facts.evidence: No, Radek wants us to say it together, but we keep postponing it.

facts.heading: Daughter Aniška suspected arguing
facts.content: Aniška asked Jana if they were arguing with her father last week.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if we were arguing with dad.

facts.heading: Jana lied to daughter about arguing
facts.content: Jana told her daughter they were not arguing, though she felt terrible.
facts.evidence: I said no. I felt terrible.

facts.heading: Jana fears ruining daughter's life
facts.content: Jana worries she will ruin Aniška's life by taking her home.
facts.evidence: That I would ruin her life, that I would take her home.

facts.heading: Jana afraid of children's tears
facts.content: Jana is afraid of the tears her children might cry during the truth.
facts.evidence: I'd rather have it with me, but I'm afraid of their tears.

facts.heading: Jana keeps apartment with children
facts.content: The apartment is in the pharmacy; children will stay with Jana.
facts.evidence: The apartment is in the pharmacy, Radek is going to his brother, at least so far. The children will stay with me.

facts.heading: Jana works as Czech teacher
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.

facts.heading: Jana teaches 8th and 9th graders
facts.content: Jana teaches 9th and 8th graders at her school.
facts.evidence: I teach 9th and 8th graders.

facts.heading: Jana feels empty after divorce
facts.content: Jana felt empty and then angry after Radka announced the divorce.
facts.evidence: Empty. Then anger. Then again emptiness.

facts.heading: Jana blames herself for blindness
facts.content: Jana thinks she should have seen signs of the divorce earlier.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I'm blind.

facts.heading: Jana considers herself too tired
facts.content: Jana sometimes thinks she was too tired to care about the marriage issues.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired and I didn't care about it.

facts.heading: Jana considers herself too worried
facts.content: Jana sometimes thinks she was too worried about the marriage issues.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I thought I was too much worried.

facts.heading: Jana glad to earn money
facts.content: Jana is glad she always managed to earn money.
facts.evidence: I'm glad I always managed to earn money.

facts.heading: Teaches with child in lap
facts.content: Jana studies with a little boy in her lap.
facts.evidence: I go to class with a little boy in my lap.

facts.heading: Feels life falling apart
facts.content: Jana feels everyone sees her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I feel like everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Told teacher about crying
facts.content: Jana told her teacher she once cried at the dance.
facts.evidence: I told her that because I once cried at the dance.

facts.heading: Teacher let her leave early
facts.content: The teacher let Jana leave school an hour early.
facts.evidence: She gave me a free hour.

facts.heading: Sleeps until 3 a.m.
facts.content: Jana wakes up at 3 a.m. every night.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3 a.m.

facts.heading: Has no mortgage or husband
facts.content: Jana has no mortgage and no husband.
facts.evidence: I have no mortgage, no husband, nothing.

facts.heading: Lost 4 kilos
facts.content: Jana has lost 4 kilos of weight.
facts.evidence: I lost 4 kilos.

facts.heading: Friend Eva wants her to struggle
facts.content: Jana's friend Eva wants Jana to have a hard time.
facts.evidence: She just wants me to have a hard time.

facts.heading: Afraid of being bad example
facts.content: Jana fears she is not a good example for her children.
facts.evidence: That a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Mother said marriage is fixed
facts.content: Jana's mother said marriage is a thing and it is what it is.
facts.evidence: She always said that marriage is a thing and that it's what it is.

facts.heading: Mother hopes Jana is good
facts.content: Jana's mother hopes Jana has been good to her.
facts.evidence: She said that she hopes I've been good to her.

facts.heading: Mother hasn't called much
facts.content: Jana's mother has not called her much since then.
facts.evidence: She hasn't called me much since then.

facts.heading: Feels sad and needs forgiveness
facts.content: Jana feels sad and needs the therapist to forgive her.
facts.evidence: Sad. I need you to forgive me.

facts.heading: Cries and apologizes when speaking
facts.content: Jana cries and apologizes when she says things out loud.
facts.evidence: I cry and I apologize.

facts.heading: Hasn't told anyone yet
facts.content: Jana has not told anyone about her feelings yet.
facts.evidence: I haven't told anyone yet.

facts.heading: Tries German tea for sleep
facts.content: Jana drinks German tea to help her sleep.
facts.evidence: German tea and that's all.

facts.heading: Refuses doctor's sleep powder
facts.content: Jana refuses the doctor's sleep powder because she doesn't want to be dependent.
facts.evidence: I don't want to be dependent.
